g.text: A third-party app gets scoped access without ever seeing the user's password
2. Login + consent screen: "this app wants to read your calendar"
3. Redirect back with code=AUTH_CODE (single-use, expires in ~60s)
Steps 1-4 travel through the browser's redirect URL -- only the single-use CODE is ever exposed there.
Steps 5-6 are server-to-server -- the ACCESS TOKEN never touches the browser, a URL, or history.
Session vs. JWT: the revocation trade-off
